_notes: Project-local MCP starter config for GT Factory OS.
All entries are placeholders. Credentials must be supplied out-of-band and referenced via environment variables.
No entry here claims working credentials. UNRESOLVED credential dependencies are listed in the README's 'Unresolved' section.
Enable a server by removing the 'disabled: true' flag and supplying the referenced env vars.

filesystem-canonical._description: Filesystem access scoped to the canonical GT Factory OS repo. Read/write under the repo root only.
filesystem-canonical._enable_notes: Requires @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem to be installed. Run: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem <path>. Path below assumes canonical repo location from memory; confirm before enabling.

github._description: GitHub API access for PRs, issues, repo metadata.
github._enable_notes: Requires a GitHub personal access token with repo scope. Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in environment. UNRESOLVED: which GitHub org/repo hosts gt-factory-os (private? personal?). Confirm before enabling.

postgres-readonly._description: Read-only Postgres connection to the live Supabase DB. For verification queries only — no writes.
postgres-readonly._enable_notes: Requires DATABASE_URL_POOLED_READONLY in environment pointing at aws-1-eu-central-1.pooler.supabase.com:5432 with a role that has SELECT-only grants on the operational schema. Do NOT reuse the migration-capable DATABASE_URL_POOLED — this connection must be grant-limited to reads. UNRESOLVED: whether a readonly role has been provisioned in Supabase.

sentry._enable_notes: Placeholder. No Sentry project is provisioned for GT Factory OS yet. UNRESOLVED: whether a Sentry project exists and its DSN/token.

linear._enable_notes: Placeholder. GT Factory OS issues are not tracked in Linear today. UNRESOLVED: whether Tom uses Linear/Jira/GitHub Issues for this project.
